_comment: The rules of the game (services/Game). Draft numbers — tune freely, no code needed. order: the nine circles from the top down (story/circles.json). The circle a fall begins in: the heaviest sin among the circles no fall has begun in yet (all at zero: limbo); then all nine are open again. attempt: the minutes between tries to get out (each try is a trial scene in the circle — story/scenes, trigger "trial"); pactAfter: from this many failed tries in one circle the trial offers the pact; limboAfter: trials answered with silence (this fall) before the player sinks into the limbo outcome; limboReturn: minutes away from the computer (locked, asleep) before the angel finds them in limbo. actions: what the player does outside the scenes and which sin it weighs ({set} like a scene's, `every`: at most once per that many minutes; `realm`: only in heaven or hell).

pace._comment: Heaven ⇄ hell, the shows. quickSwitch: seconds — a switch this soon after the last one is instant: no circle splash, no quake, no breaking glass, no sound (someone clicking back and forth). soundGap: seconds between two plays of the same transition sound (the blow, the rocks, the glass, the choir) — they never pile up.

throw.push.note: the angel pushed down slowly, on purpose

wheel.spin.note: a spin of the Wheel of Hell

plea.early.note: begging again before the time is up

choice.silent.note: any answer of the silent tone, in any scene
